suggestions.title: Include Counterparty ID in List Contracts API Response
suggestions.summary: Add Counterparty ID to GET /api/v2.1/public/contracts so customers can uniquely link contracts to counterparties without matching on name.
suggestions.slackMessage:
Ceracare: Include Counterparty ID in List Contracts API Response

Feature Request:
The customer has requested that the List Contracts API (GET /api/v2.1/public/contracts) include the Counterparty ID in its response payload.
Current Limitation:

The API currently returns the Counterparty Name but does not return the associated Counterparty ID.
This prevents customers from reliably establishing a relationship between a contract and its corresponding counterparty.
As a workaround, customers can call the Get Counterparties API, but this requires matching on counterparty name (or email), which is not a reliable approach.
Customer Concern:

Counterparty names are not guaranteed to be unique, so joining records based on name can lead to incorrect mappings.
The contract response does not include a counterparty email either. The available email fields relate to the user who uploaded or created the contract, not the counterparty.
Because of this, there is currently no unique identifier available in the List Contracts API response to associate a contract with its counterparty.
Requested Enhancement:
 Include the Counterparty ID (or equivalent unique counterparty identifier) in the response payload of the List Contracts API (GET /api/v2.1/public/contracts).

CC: @pt @Anagh Padmanabhan @Deepti Shukla
